title: Michael Penix: I'm running my own race, can't look into another lane

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Michael Penix: I'm running my own race, can't look into another lane
sources.description: Falcons quarterback Michael Penix isn't a full participant in the team's OTA practices this week, but his recovery from a torn ACL has gone well enough for him to take part in 7-on-7 work at this point in the offseason.
